added_failures_note: The reviewed manifest records no baseline_suite and no after_suite arm (both null). Its single gate.log names head revision 9422314a0 and shows 147 passed, 0 failed, EXIT=0, which this review reproduced; a head arm with no failing id cannot have added a failure, so added_failure_count reads 0 with no ids. No base arm was measured, so no base/head subtraction was possible.

findings.text: follow-on: the fragment says a choice must carry a probability for each offered criterion and no other, but _validate_decisions_answers in imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py enforces only that every probability key is an offered criterion and that the probabilities sum to 1 within 0.01; a criterion left absent is accepted as 0, so the prose overstates the check it describes.

follow-on: the reviewed manifest records neither baseline_suite nor after_suite, so the run holds no measured added-failure pair for the promotion audit to read; added_failure_count is derived as 0 from the zero-failure head arm alone.

follow-on: a missing or non-numeric usage.cost raises DecisionsValidationError, the class documented as a non-retryable deterministic answer-contract violation; a response whose only deficiency is an absent usage block, more plausibly transient than a malformed noul, therefore fails without retry.

item_verdicts.diff: three commits over base 7f2a6414b - 3e91ac114 (llm.py +321/-5, settings.py +5, pyproject.toml +7), 37acb4cce (tests/conftest.py +38, tests/discovery/test_llm_decisions.py +254) and 9422314a0 (the evidence fragment +69) - 689 insertions and 5 deletions across six files.
item_verdicts.done_when: the node's declared measure is its gate; the reviewed manifest records 147 passed EXIT=0 at head 9422314a0, and I reproduced exactly that (147 passed, 2 warnings in 12.04s, EXIT=0) plus the declared mutation (choice-membership check deleted -> test_choice_outside_criteria_is_refused DID NOT RAISE, EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal: the decisions-call node's goal is the canonical call layer for the OpenRouter decisions endpoint plus the discovery-relevance seat and their tests; imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py lands call_decisions and acall_decisions posting {model,state,questions} to https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions, and get_model('discovery-relevance') resolves to typesafe/jev-1.13.
item_verdicts.manifest: present and self-consistent (status complete; commits 3e91ac114, 37acb4cce, 9422314a0; gate.log and negative-control.log named; a negative-control note; blockers none), but it records no baseline_suite and no after_suite arm.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares seven write paths; the three-commit diff touches six files (imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py, imas_codex/settings.py, pyproject.toml, tests/conftest.py, tests/discovery/test_llm_decisions.py and the evidence fragment), every one inside the declared set, and nothing outside it.

justifications.durability: tests/discovery/test_llm_decisions.py:159 fails if the choice-membership check is removed (reproduced, EXIT=1) and each of the six refusals pins an independent guard; one deduction because a missing usage.cost raises the non-retryable validation type.
justifications.evidence: the gate the manifest names is recorded in gate.log and I reproduced it at head (147 passed, EXIT=0) and its negative control (EXIT=1); one deduction because the reviewed record carries no baseline/after arm, so its measured added-failure pair is absent.
justifications.fit: the added symbols are mechanism-named (call_decisions, _service_headers, _decisions_retryable) and the commits are conventional with bodies; the docstring and fragment prose carry no plan identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:3239 and :3497 land the call layer beside call_llm_structured, imas_codex/settings.py registers the seat, and a probe returned get_model('discovery-relevance') = typesafe/jev-1.13 with request and answer shapes matching the prototype's real responses.
justifications.reuse: imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:1995 extracts _service_headers and _build_kwargs calls it, _decisions_retryable delegates to _is_retryable, and the repository search found no prior owner of a decisions-endpoint call layer.
